title: SCOTTY CRANMER AND THE 5 MILE BIKE RIDE CHALLENGE!
description: I decided to take my 29 inch bike over to the Manasquan reservoir where there is a 5 mile fitness trail to test my ability! It was a rainy day so I figured it would be perfect for me to try because there would be less people on the trail. It wasn't easy I challenge myself with a couple hills that made me a bit nervous but to my surprise I was able to make it to the top of both of them! My body started getting sore so I decided that I would stop at the halfway mark and have big boy finish the trail on his own and pick up the truck to come get me! I'm so happy to be on my bike and I am excited to get back on the true test myself soon!
author: Scotty Cranmer
